author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
When an 80 year old investment legend talks about how AI can disrupt the economy, you have to listen carefully.  Especially when he can understand and explain everything very well.

He is not a tech bro from within the AI bubble, he is from the same places as Warren Buffett.
